svg.aria-label: Your rifle to Alaska and back, in six steps. 1: buy your Alaska hunting licence online; the ATF, the US Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms and Explosives, needs a copy of it with your application. 2: file ATF Form 6NIA, one per hunter; about 4 to 6 weeks; approval is valid 1 year. 3: leave Canada; optional: CBSA, Canada Border Services Agency, card BSF407 listing serial numbers. 4: at the US border, CBP, Customs and Border Protection, declare the firearm and show the approved 6NIA plus the Alaska licence. 5: hunt; keep the 6NIA and licence on you; unloaded and cased in the truck is the safe habit. 6: back into Canada, CBSA: declare it and show your PAL, Possession and Acquisition Licence; non restricted re entry only. Ammunition rides on the same 6NIA. Keep every paper in one folder.
